asv.title: Add server
asv.confirm.empty: No connection requests. Install the agent on a new server: by a link, over SSH, or by hand with the data below.
asv.confirm.codeHint: Must match the code shown on the client.
asv.confirm.viaInfo: It came by your link "{via}": no key is needed. The server name is taken from the agent.
asv.confirm.tooMany: Too many attempts, the request was rejected
asv.avail.title: Connected, not on the dashboard
asv.avail.empty: All connected servers are already on the dashboard.
asv.connect.title: Client connection data
asv.connect.hint: Use them when you install the agent by hand on a managed server. The agent port does not go through a reverse proxy: the address must lead to this server directly.
asv.link.lead: Create a link and run the command on the new server as root. The agent downloads the release from this server (from its cache, not from GitHub), connects by itself and shows up in the Confirmations tab. The agent reports the server name itself.
asv.link.netsHint: Without a list the link works from any address.
asv.link.netsBad: Networks: enter addresses or CIDRs separated by commas
asv.link.autoHint: Without it every server that came by the link waits for you to press Confirm. Turn it on for a mass rollout, together with a list of networks.
asv.link.onceRest: the panel keeps only a hash of the token. Valid for {ttl}, servers: {max}, {mode}.
asv.link.extHint: For servers outside your network: the address at which this server is seen from the internet.
asv.link.locHint: For servers in the same network as the panel: faster, and it does not leave the network.
asv.link.scriptHint: Read the script before you run it: it can be opened at the same link.
asv.link.why: The server has its own certificate, so the usual check of the certificate chain does not fit. Instead, the command checks that it is your server that answers: the hash of its key is built into the command. The script cannot be swapped on the way.
asv.ssh.lead: The panel connects to the server over SSH, checks it and installs the agent. You do not need to confirm the request afterwards: logging in over SSH has already proved the server is yours.
asv.ssh.blocked: This address is not allowed: the panel does not use loopback and cloud metadata addresses (169.254.0.0/16).
asv.ssh.secrets: The credentials travel over HTTPS only, stay in the memory of the server while the check and the install run (15 minutes at most), and are written nowhere, the log included. The audit log keeps the address, the login and the result.
asv.ssh.tooMany: Too many attempts, wait a few minutes.
asv.ssh.expired: The install session expired. Start again.
asv.ssh.step.download: Downloading the agent from the server
asv.ssh.step.verify: Checking the signature and the hash
asv.ssh.step.rollback: Rollback: the service is stopped, the agent is removed from the host
asv.ssh.note.hostkeyAsk: Compare the fingerprint with the server console or the hosting panel
asv.ssh.note.agentExists: An agent {version} is already installed: it will be replaced
asv.ssh.note.agentExistsNoVer: An agent is already installed: it will be replaced
asv.ssh.gate.hostkeyText: The panel connects to this host for the first time. Key fingerprint ({type}):
asv.ssh.gate.hostkeyWarn: If the key is not the right one, someone may be intercepting the connection, and the password would go to a server that is not yours.
asv.ssh.gate.sudoText: for the user {login}. It is only used during the install and is not stored.
asv.ssh.gate.sudoRetry: The password was not accepted. Enter the sudo password again.
asv.ssh.gate.addrTitle: The host could not reach the server
asv.ssh.gate.addrText: The agent connects to the server by itself, so port {port} must be open on the side of the host (firewall, NAT, cloud rules). You can try another address of the server:
asv.ssh.gate.reinstallTitle: The host already has an agent
asv.ssh.gate.reinstallText: The previous agent will be replaced: it stops reporting to the old server.
asv.ssh.gate.reinstallCheck: Reinstall and connect to this server
asv.ssh.ready: Everything is ready for the install.
asv.ssh.readyApproveText: not needed: you have proved it with the SSH login
asv.ssh.logTrimmed: The last lines of {total} are shown.
asv.ssh.doneText: The name was taken from the agent. No confirmation was needed: the SSH login proved the server is yours. It is already in the list of connected servers in the Confirmations tab.
asv.ssh.err.connect_failed: Could not connect to the host over SSH. Check the address and the port, that sshd is running and that the port is not blocked by a firewall.
asv.ssh.err.hostkey_rejected: You did not trust the host key, the connection was dropped.
asv.ssh.err.auth_failed: Could not sign in as {login}: wrong login or password. The panel does not try other options.
asv.ssh.err.auth_failed_key: Could not sign in as {login}: the host did not accept the key or the login. The panel does not try other options.
asv.ssh.err.key_unreadable: The private key could not be read. Check the format (OpenSSH or PEM) and the passphrase.
asv.ssh.err.command_failed: A command on the host failed. The details are in the grey text under the stage.
asv.ssh.err.os_unsupported: This system is not supported. The agent runs on Debian 12 and 13 and Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04 (amd64, and arm64 on a Raspberry Pi 4 with a 64-bit OS).
asv.ssh.err.no_systemd: systemd is not running on the host, and the agent runs as a systemd service.
asv.ssh.err.disk_low: The host has too little disk space for the agent. Free some space and check again.
asv.ssh.err.sudo_missing: The user {login} cannot use sudo, and the login is not root. Sign in as root or add the user to the sudo group.
asv.ssh.err.sudo_denied: sudo refused the user {login}: the password is wrong or commands are forbidden. Check the password and the rights.
asv.ssh.err.port_unreachable: The host could not reach the server. The agent connects to the server by itself, so the port must be open on the side of the host (firewall, NAT, cloud rules).
asv.ssh.err.token_failed: Could not issue a one-time token for the install. Try again.
asv.ssh.err.release_missing: The server has no release of the agent for this system. Put it into the cache on the updates page.
asv.ssh.err.curl_failed: curl could not run on the host or could not find the server. Install curl and check the connection from the host to the server.
asv.ssh.err.download_failed: Could not download the agent from the server. Check the connection from the host to the server and try again.
asv.ssh.err.checksum_mismatch: The hash or the signature of the downloaded file does not match the signed manifest. The file was not installed: it may have been damaged on the way.
asv.ssh.err.install_failed: The installer of the agent on the host failed. The details are in the output below.
asv.ssh.err.not_bound: The agent started, but the server did not accept its binding request. The install was cancelled.
asv.ssh.err.not_connected: The agent is installed but did not connect to the server within 60 seconds. Most likely the outgoing port is blocked by the firewall of the host, or the server address is not reachable from it. The install was cancelled, and the host is as it was.
